Class QTileRegistry

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.data.QTileRegistry
public class QTileRegistry extends Object
Static registry that holds all board tile data loaded from the client-side JSON resource file. The registry is populated once at class initialization and provides lookup methods to retrieve tile attributes by tile ID.
